criteria.rationale: The August 2026 note, within 180 days of the request, documents that the patient continues the diet and exercise plan and will continue it with Wegovy. The earlier note specifies a reduced-calorie meal plan and brisk walking.
The latest structured BMI is 29.8, below 30 but above 27. No qualifying weight-related comorbid condition is documented to support the BMI ≥27 pathway.

missing_requirements: Documentation of at least one qualifying weight-related comorbid condition for the BMI ≥27 pathway.
parsed.summary: The documented diet and activity plan meets the adjunct-use criterion. The BMI criterion cannot be established because the latest BMI is 29.8 and a qualifying weight-related comorbidity is not documented.
